title: Weighted Hodge Laplacians on Manifolds with Boundary
summary: The spectrum of the Hodge Laplacian on differential manifolds encodes rich topological and geometric information and thus provides a powerful tool for analyzing data on manifolds. However, the classical unweighted formulation is restricted in its ability to study data with varying local features. To address this limitation, we propose a weighted Hodge Laplacian framework for manifolds with boundary, both in theory and in computation, by incorporating a weight function on the manifold.
